title: drivers/bluetooth/hci_qca.c (mainline)
takes: qca_suspend: sets QCA_SUSPENDING, sends IBS SLEEP_IND, waits 200 ms for the chip's own SLEEP_IND, returns -ETIMEDOUT otherwise (suspend then refuses); qca_wakeup follows the serial's power/wakeup

title: drivers/tty/serial/qcom_geni_serial.c (mainline)
takes: the isr returns IRQ_NONE while uport->suspended (a level irq asserted then is a 'nobody cared' storm); dedicated wake irq from a second interrupt; runtime/system suspend path

title: sc7180-trogdor.dtsi &uart3 and qup_uart3_sleep (mainline)
takes: the one mainline QCA UART Bluetooth that sleeps in s2idle by design: interrupts-extended with tlmm 41 EDGE_FALLING, pinctrl sleep (CTS pull-down matching the module, RTS pull-down = chip may wake the system, TX and RX pull-up), wcn3991-bt

title: SteamOS issue 2845: QCA2066 Bluetooth times out after S4
takes: unbinding only the serdev from hci_uart_qca before sleep and binding after is a working user-space workaround when the controller loses state; IBS wake byte accepted but 0x0c01 times out -110

title: ArchWiki Bluetooth: Bluetooth immediately waking up suspend-to-idle devices
takes: on s2idle systems the controller stays enabled and its traffic wakes the system; the usual remedy is bluetoothctl power off before sleep and on after

title: drivers/base/regmap/regmap-irq.c (regmap_irq_sync_unlock)
takes: The message 'IRQ sync failed to resume: N' is pm_runtime_get_sync() on the codec failing inside an irq mask/unmask; -16 is -EBUSY, so the codec's runtime PM could not resume while its parent chain was down

title: sound/soc/codecs/wcd937x-sdw.c (runtime resume, regcache sync)
takes: Mainline wcd9370 resume is only a regcache sync; no ADSP-restart handling, no system-sleep ops - so a crash of the ADSP under it has no mainline answer

title: drivers/remoteproc/qcom_q6v5_pas.c (adsp crash handling)
takes: A fatal error of the ADSP is handled as a recovery (stop, reload, start) while the audio drivers above it stay bound

title: UAPI.1 The Boot Loader Specification - Boot counting
takes: The boot loader decrements 'tries left' each time it boots an entry, before the OS runs; an entry at 0 is 'bad' and sorts after all others; the counter is a file rename on the ESP.

title: Initramfs/Inspecting (postmarketOS wiki, Nura mirror)
takes: pmos.debug-shell halts the boot and opens a shell on the USB serial gadget (CONFIG_USB_CONFIGFS_ACM) and telnet 172.16.42.1; that is the only built-in initramfs channel, and it stops the boot.

title: Ramoops oops/panic logger (kernel documentation)
takes: Ramoops keeps console/panic records in reserved RAM; they survive a reset that keeps DRAM powered and are read from pstore on the next boot.

title: systemd-system.conf(5): RuntimeWatchdogSec, RebootWatchdogSec
takes: RebootWatchdogSec (default 10 min) arms the hardware watchdog in systemd-shutdown, the second phase of a reboot, so a stuck reboot is reset; no effect without a watchdog device.

title: qpnp-power-on.c (Android MSM kernel): qpnp_pon_reason table, PON_REASON1 ffs index
takes: PON_REASON1 bit 0 is hard reset, index = ffs-1

title: mainline drivers/watchdog/pm8916_wdt.c and drivers/power/reset/qcom-pon.c (v7.3)
takes: POFF_REASON1 PMIC_WD is BIT(2); qcom-pon never reads PON_REASON1
